ASCENT artifact-qualified evidence and dependency joins
Exact Bazel O1/O3 bootstrap and scoped native controls
OPEN: C simulation, complete root/writer coverage and pre-flip C planner; commit blocked
Source upper bound may become capacity evidence only after unique scanning and destination packing are proved.
Old collective publishes abort_isolated before healthy GC; detached empty intervals may be reused, stable native identity must not be overwritten.
Disjoint chunk traversal requests do not replace the per-object write claim; copy-winner Tail and special frame links retain separate custody.
A scanner claiming a raw-ready frame must acquire the frame domain before reading the structural link or ordinary roots; constructor writes precede release.
Private grants and known-result refunds provide physical accounting premises; they do not alone establish U, Amax or a pre-flip whole-round grant.
Captured-frame payload construction uses the same contiguous reservation and commit endpoints; frame/link publication does not erase allocation debt.
READY certifies Scheme initialization for one generation; successful join closes its native identity before slot overwrite.
A readiness waiter remains a GC participant with a complete C-FFI root origin; no native lock is held while servicing GC.
Local cancellation is only one term of whole-round physical accounting and cannot authorize a parity flip or refund section publication.
Observed known loss uses the production reservation and cancellation functions; a scheduler control may not write the CAS result or fabricate accounting.
All source slots join the frozen VM root inventory before source-word census and copying. Root aliases do not justify duplicated copy work or a larger heap.
Selection reloads the source cell; ledger then context startup roots take responsibility before source ACK. Managed readiness starts after source transport drain and owns no source-root dependency.

Reserve the fixed registry outside the GC transaction and include its payload reachability in the closed source inventory. A valid root handoff cannot authorize parity flip without the separate physical layout receipt.
